_comment: Desired Cloud Scheduler jobs, reconciled on every deploy by scripts/scheduler_reconcile.py. Each job is created as lemely-<environment>-<id>. Adding an entry creates it, editing one updates it, and removing or renaming one deletes the old job, but only jobs carrying the lemely-deploy ownership marker are ever deleted. `secret` names a GitHub secret (per environment); the deploy step must also map it into its env. An empty secret skips that job with a warning and never deletes it, unless the job is `required`, which makes it a deploy error (checked by `--preflight` before any migration runs too). Delivery policy is per job: maxRetryAttempts, minBackoff, maxBackoff, attemptDeadline (defaults: 3, 6m, 30m, none; the digest relies on the defaults). See docs/ci-cd.md.

jobs.description: Daily waitlist applicant digest to the team
